156:184.en: 「Can I not fight on like this?!」

156:270.en: 「That won't be enough to sink me!」

156:743.en: 「A fine attack!\nBut I won't die yet!」

156:834.en: 「Ugh! You have some skill after all!」

156:869.en: 「Ngh! You want me to get serious.」

156:973.en: 「Tch! An attack from out of range?!」

156:1006.en: 「That won't make you a match for me!」

156:1133.en: 「Is that the extent of your ability?!」

156:1354.en:
「I would like a code name
as well. Let me see...
The wind that quells fires.
Let me call myself Wind.」

156:1465.en: 「I was dead. But as long as $$トレーズ$$'s ghost still wanders, I can't lie quietly in my coffin.」

156:1644.en: 「That won't work! Not at that level!!」

156:1820.en: 「I'll end this with a single blow!」

156:1972.en: 「Even someone like me\ncan be of use!」

156:2021.en: 「At least let me do this much!」

156:2118.en: 「This is as far as you go!!」

156:2292.en: 「Let me see what that power can do!」

156:2358.en: 「$$ウイングゼロ$$! Show me victory!」

156:2476.en: 「Lifeless dolls are no match for me!」

156:2667.en: 「In war, you take out the commander!」

156:2825.en: 「I won't let total peace be denied!」

156:3356.en: 「I won't be bested in single combat!」

156:3523.en: 「At this rate, I'm a sitting duck!」

156:3630.en: 「I won't stay in your sights forever.」

156:3892.en: 「To think even I left an opening...!」

156:4024.en: 「$$ウイングゼロ$$ has taken this much...!」

156:4063.en: 「You can fight me as an equal!」

156:4326.en: 「Some things only a dead man\ncan do!」

156:4375.en: 「Now I'm Wind, here to quench fires!」

156:4412.en: 「$$ミリアルド・ピースクラフト$$\nwon't return!」

156:4475.en: 「If even I can still be useful...!」

156:4516.en: 「I died once!\nI can take some risks!」

156:4813.en: 「What do you seek as the $$赤い彗星$$?!」

156:5100.en: 「I snuff war's spark! That's my duty!」

156:5331.en: 「You rule people and steal freedom...\nThat makes you my enemy!」

156:5382.en: 「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$!\nYou are my enemy!」

156:5431.en: 「I fight you to create the future!」

156:5470.en: 「This world's fate is decided\nby all who live in it!」

156:5622.en: 「$$カトル$$, leave the rest to me.」

156:5837.en: 「A Grim Reaper can't very well die!」

156:6090.en: 「The name Wind is no mere boast!」

156:6191.en: 「If my machine moves, I fight on!」

156:6224.en: 「I knew the risk from the start!」

156:6292.en: 「Not yet! My duty\nis not over yet!」

156:6353.en: 「$$トレーズ$$!\nI won't join you yet!」

156:6513.en: 「Shed past and mask. Free your heart.」
